description: Pair-level scan configuration for Optimism mainnet. Wave 6 priority is testing the Ramses-class hypothesis on a third chain: does Velodrome Slipstream exhibit a Ramses-style lag signature, or does it match Aerodrome Slipstream's BEHAVIORALLY_DEAD pattern? Velodrome is the direct ancestor protocol of Aerodrome, so structural similarity is expected — the question is whether market behavior on Optimism diverges meaningfully from Base.

pairs.label: ETH/USDC
pairs.note: Token sort: USDC native (0x0b2C) < WETH (0x4200) → token0=USDC, token1=WETH. This is OPPOSITE of Base where USDC (0x8335) > WETH so token0=WETH. priceMode='invert' flips the raw on-chain ratio (WETH per USDC = 0.0005) to give USDC per WETH = $2000 for display. Depth calc detects stable side automatically via STABLE_TOKENS set in multi_pair_pool_discovery.js — see wave6 commit 2.
